reports.title: Gemeentefonds — Algemene Uitkering (Municipal Fund General Grant)
reports.publisher: Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) / Ministerie van Financiën
reports.description: The Dutch national government's main unconditional equalization transfer to all Dutch municipalities, distributed under the Financiële-verhoudingswet via a formula (the 'verdeelmodel') set out in the Besluit financiële verhouding 2001 (Bfv 2001). The structural Dutch analog to Ontario's OMPF and Alberta's LGFF — the closest EU parallel this branch has found yet to the Canada branch's own provincial-to-municipal fiscal-transfer nodes.
reports.cadence_note: Distributed via three annual circulaires (meicirculaire, septembercirculaire, decembercirculaire), each updating the allocation for the current and future years.

reports.title: Provinciefonds — Algemene Uitkering (Provincial Fund General Grant)
reports.publisher: Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) / Ministerie van Financiën

release_schedule.note: BZK/Financien publish three circulaires per year for the provinciefonds (meicirculaire in late May, septembercirculaire in mid-September, decembercirculaire in December), mirroring the identical schedule for the gemeentefonds. No fixed-date calendar is published in advance; dates are inferred from the consistent pattern of past editions. The septembercirculaire has coincided with Prinsjesdag (the constitutionally fixed third Tuesday of September) in each of the last three years observed (2023-09-19, 2024-09-17, 2025-09-16), so 2026-09-15 (Prinsjesdag 2026) is a high-confidence projection. reports.description: The accounting standard (an algemene maatregel van bestuur issued under Gemeentewet art. 186 and Provinciewet art. 190) that governs how every Dutch municipality and province must prepare its budget, multi-year estimate and annual financial statements. release_schedule.note: BBV is a Royal Decree (AMvB) setting budgeting/accounting rules for Dutch provinces and municipalities, not a recurring statistical publication. It is amended irregularly via separate 'Wijzigingsbesluiten' (amendment decrees) whenever policy change is needed -- e.g. the 'interne sturing' amendment (BWBR0037728) and the ongoing internet consultation on 'rechtmatigheidsverantwoording'. wetten.overheid.nl shows the current consolidated text in force since 2025-04-17 (page last technically updated 2026-07-02) with no stated periodic revision cycle. The annual budget/accounting cycle it prescribes for municipalities/provinces should not be confused with a release schedule for the decree itself.

reports.title: Wet waardering onroerende zaken (Wet WOZ)
reports.description: The national law requiring every Dutch municipality to determine an annual market value ('WOZ-waarde') for every real-estate object in its territory, executed by the municipal college van burgemeester en wethouders. Functions in this corpus the way `esa-2010` or `sna-2008` do — a legally-established methodology standard other documents cite as their valuation basis, rather than a periodical release. VERIFIED DIRECTLY: wetten.overheid.nl BWBR0007119 downloaded and parsed for the operative articles.
reports.cadence_note: Art. 22 lid 2: the value fixed by a municipality's beschikking 'geldt voor een kalenderjaar' (applies for one calendar year) — an annual valuation cycle.

release_schedule.rule: Wet WOZ, artikel 24 lid 1: "De beschikking wordt genomen binnen acht weken na het begin van het kalenderjaar waarvoor zij geldt." (The WOZ-beschikking [property value assessment notice] must be issued within eight weeks after the start of the calendar year for which it applies.) Article 18 lid 2 sets the valuation reference date (waardepeildatum) as one year before the start of that calendar year.

entries.covers: WOZ-beschikking for calendar year 2027 (waardepeildatum 1 January 2026)

release_schedule.note: The 2026-cycle deadline (8 weeks after 1 January 2026, i.e. ~26 February 2026) has already passed relative to today (2026-08-11), so the next occurrence shown is the 2027 cycle. In practice nearly all municipalities issue the WOZ-beschikking combined with the annual municipal tax bill (gemeentelijke belastingaanslag) before 1 March each year, consistent with this 8-week statutory deadline. No published multi-year calendar of exact dates exists; the date above is computed from the statutory rule, not read off a calendar.
